# rd_vu_zero_ab, rd_vu_zero_gl and rd_vu_zero_fault (test/rd_vu_zero_ab.cmake), and
# rd_ab_zero_ab and rd_ab_zero_stop (test/rd_ab_zero_ab.cmake: the profiles alone):
# a fixture, the profiles it is replayed under (corpus, mali, mali169: the
# script's head says what each is; OpenGL replays every fixture at the corpus
# settings alone), then the property the test checks
# (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake), holding for each of its profiles over that
# profile's ICO_RD_VU_ZERO=1 runs together:
#   vu_zero_culled  the triangle slots the checks read back found culled
#                   (rd_vu_zero.h: no sample point of the target in them)
# One setting of a profile may find nothing to cull in a frame (the 2x
# lattice samples twice as finely as 1x); the script also wants at least one
# triangle culled at 2x over the whole list.
# The Pixel's profile is not here: its Enhanced resolution is no whole
# number of texels a GS pixel, so the cull is refused there (rd_vu_zero_test
# t1).
#
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (moto g24 power, v0.11.5): the stage 42 slow-scene
# capture at 21:9 (912 GS pixels wide).  A light frame: about 2,000 mesh
# triangles on the target, 8 triangle slots culled at 1x (all in list 5) and
# none at 2x (the merge check of 2026-11-21 09:02, and the same counts from
# the dump's mesh triangles through the cull's own test)
fx-mali-slow541 mali,mali169,corpus vu_zero_culled>=1
#
# issue 123's Adreno (v0.11.7), at 3:2 (576 GS pixels wide; the 16:9 setting
# cannot show it, the Enhanced 4:3 one can): about 2,500 mesh triangles on
# the target, of which about 160 cover no sample point at 1x and about 30 at
# 2x (counted from the dump through the cull's own test, the corners
# projected from the mesh stream: an estimate, not the replay's)
fx-adreno corpus vu_zero_culled>=1
